FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Frequently asked questions

Is 21Life an official Magic app?

No. It is an independent, unofficial fan project and is not approved, sponsored by or affiliated with Wizards of the Coast.

Does every player need an account?

Guests can join a table without an account. An account is required to access the playgroup and personal shared data.

Can I use the same account on web and Android?

Yes. Sign in with the same account to access your group, decks and games. Data syncs while you are online.

Does it work without internet?

Not fully. You can recover an interrupted game, but accounts, syncing and deck imports need an internet connection.

How do I update the Android app?

Use Obtainium with the 21Life GitHub address, or download the APK from official releases. Keep the same edition when updating.

Is it available on iPhone or iPad?

On iPhone and iPad, use the web app in your browser. 21Life is not available on the App Store.

How do I delete my account and data?

Permanently delete your account in the app Settings. See the section below or contact support if you cannot sign in. Never send passwords or tokens when contacting support.

PRIVACY & TERMS

Privacy and your account

This site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure visits and page views without analytics cookies. Statistics are only accessible to the site owner. For app accounts and data, read the privacy policy.

Account deletion

Open the app Settings to permanently delete your account. If you cannot sign in, contact support@21life.win. See the privacy policy for data retention and handling.

FAQ

Before you start

Is 21Life free and open source?

Yes. The code is public under the MIT license. The life counter, game history, statistics, playgroups, seasons and awards are free, with no paid feature tier.

How do I import decks from Moxfield or Archidekt?

Open the deck section in your profile, choose import and paste the deck link. Review the result and save it. Imports need an internet connection and do not change your original list.

Is 21Life an official Moxfield app?

No. It is an independent Commander / EDH project that imports decks from Moxfield and Archidekt. It is not affiliated with either service or Wizards of the Coast.

Is 21Life available on F-Droid?

Coming soon. The submission is under review. For now, download the official APK from GitHub, follow updates with Obtainium or use the web app.

Does every player need an account?

No. You need an account to manage the playgroup and save shared history and statistics. Other players can join as guests without their own accounts.

Are there ads or paid features?

No. Group statistics, seasons and awards are included too. You can inspect, modify and redistribute the code under the MIT license terms.

What data is processed?

Accounts and shared games need data to work and sync. Imports and images use external services. The presentation website measures visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, without analytics cookies. Read the policy for details.
